review.finding: The link key is task.projectId:triageId, but the Fix-now modal lets the user change the target project before saving. If a different project is picked, the task is stored under that project, the card never shows the In progress box and Fix now stays available, so a second task can be created for the same item.
review.suggestion: Only send fixNowForTriageId when the selected project equals the item's own project (initialProjectId). Add a test for the changed-project case.

review.finding: Only done releases a link. Tasks in launch_failed or jsonl_missing keep the item In progress with Resolve and no Fix now, so a failed launch cannot be retried from the card. Also createdAt strings are compared lexically.
review.suggestion: Decide whether launch_failed releases the link and test it. Compare with Date.parse.

review.finding: Popover content is outside the card DOM and has no onKeyDown stopPropagation; an ancestor key handler could see Enter/Space.
review.suggestion: Optional hardening: stop key propagation on Content.

review.finding: The popover has no accessible name; autoFocus is used instead of onOpenAutoFocus.
Every card runs select over the full task list; memoized per query so acceptable. The query key is shared with the Board.
review.suggestion: Confirm the Board queryFn returns the same ExternalTask[] shape.

review.finding: Strict regex on create and on load; no injection possible. Object.assign after store.create relies on create returning the live object; the reload test shows it works.
The new import was inserted above the Hono type import, breaking ordering.
review.suggestion: Move it down with the other core imports.
